description: Use this to get from a stream to something you can edit: pass streamId and you get the two playlists that stream owns — one video, one audio, created empty with it. Pass sceneId for the playlists a scene's sources play. Also the way to find a playlist id before any other playlist tool. Returns a page of rows (id, name, streamID, sceneId, kind, mode, version, createdAt) plus nextCursor and total; get_playlist has the items.

after.description: The `nextCursor` from a previous page of this same tool.

createdAfter.description: Only items created at or after this RFC3339 time, e.g. 2026-05-01T00:00:00Z.

createdBefore.description: Only items created at or before this RFC3339 time.

first.description: How many rows to return on this page; 20 when omitted.

kind.description: Only playlists of this media kind: the picture track or the background audio track.

sceneId.description: Only playlists belonging to this scene (scn_...).

sort.description: Order rows by creation time; newest first when omitted.

streamId.description: Only the playlists of this stream: its id (stream_...), from list_streams or create_stream.

name: list_playlists

hasMore.description: Whether there is a next page.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `after` for the next page; null when this is the last page.

total.description: Total matching records, not just this page.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it

title: List playlists
